anatomy: Floating spiral nautilus shell of ivory and saffron enamel, open glowing turquoise chamber, three thick violet tassel tentacles dangling below, narrow red eye above shell lip. No legs, no wings. Floating bob gait, tentacle lash attack, contracted recoil, fallen cracked shell death.

Limbless orange segmented ground worm, six thick white crown teeth surrounding a round turquoise mouth, broad flat head, long tapering curved tail, cobalt back plates. No legs, no arms, no wings. Coiled rest, sinuous slither gait, forward open-mouth lunge attack, bent recoil, fully limp collapsed death.

Low crawling six-legged mantis beetle, narrow long emerald body, broad opal fan tail, two huge curved spoon-shaped scarlet forelimbs held low, four thin jointed golden hind legs, triangular ivory head with black eyes. Ground scuttle gait, spoon-claw slash attack, limbs tucked hurt, fallen side curled-leg death.

Heavy squat upright stone creature with enormous round vertical sandstone millwheel back, chunky blue basalt torso, tiny inset amber face, two thick stone arms ending rectangular fists, two short pillar legs with huge feet. No weapon. Heavy walking alternating steps, raised-fist slam attack, leaned recoil, collapsed wheel and body death.

Floating split crimson pomegranate spirit, wide oval bowl body exposing glowing gold jewel seeds, tall six-point green leafy calyx, single sapphire eye, three short thick curling turquoise smoke tails beneath. No limbs, no wings. Floating bob gait, burst-open seed attack, closed recoil, shrivelled fallen fruit death.

Limbless thick teal ground serpent with long ivory rake-like comb horn above broad blunt ochre head, plated diamond gold belly, short wide spade tail. No legs, no arms, no wings. Broad S-shaped coils idle, undulating slither gait, lowered-horn forward ram attack, folded recoil, stretched limp sideways death.

Low six-legged crawling scarab with round hammered copper teapot shell, turquoise glazed circular lid on back, short wide elephant-like spout snout, loop handle tail and six broad jointed violet crab legs. Tiny bright yellow eyes. Alternating scuttle steps, forward spout-ram attack, legs tucked hurt, tipped sideways broken pot death.

Heavy broad four-legged rhinoceros monster made of white salt crystal blocks, huge terracotta anvil-shaped back with horizontal pointed ends, short orange single nose horn, small cyan eyes and four massive square feet. No arms, no wings. Slow stomping alternating gait, lowered horn charge attack, recoiling bent legs hurt, fallen sideways anvil death.
